# Methods Research Lab

::: {.lead}
We study how researchers develop, evaluate and use research methods.
:::

Research methods shape what we can learn from a study. We investigate how
researchers choose and use methods, and build tools to support their decisions.

Stefan Schandelmaier leads the Methods Research Lab at the University of Basel,
working with collaborators internationally.

The Swiss National Science Foundation supports Stefan Schandelmaier’s STREAM
project through an [Ambizione grant](https://data.snf.ch/grants/grant/223702){target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"}
(2025–2029).

## What we are working on {#projects}

Our projects address different parts of a shared question: what helps researchers
make sound decisions about methods? [TYPE-ME](#project-type-me) classifies methods
research. [STREAM](#project-stream) studies how to develop methods guidance.
[LIGHTS](#project-lights) helps researchers find methods guidance.
[ICEMAN](#project-iceman) helps them assess claims about differences in treatment
effects.

## About the group {#about}

We bring together researchers from several institutions. Most of us also run
trials, write reviews or sit on guideline panels. That experience shapes the
questions we ask and the tools we develop.
